items.definition:
a form of carbon consisting of a single layer of atoms arranged in a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice
Graphene is known for its exceptional strength and conductivity.

the branch of technology that deals with dimensions and tolerances of less than 100 nanometers
Nanotechnology has the potential to revolutionize many industries.

a ruler, especially one who is supreme over other rulers
The feudal overlord demanded tribute from his vassals.

the office or authority of the Pope
The papacy has played a significant role in European history.

a political approach that strives to appeal to ordinary people
The rise of populism has reshaped political landscapes in many countries.

a tangled mass of hair or fiber
The old carpet had a thick shag.

the process of learning to behave in a way that is acceptable to society
Early childhood socialization is crucial for development.

a division of a class
In biology, a family can be divided into subclasses.

a stitch or seam used to close a wound
The doctor used fine sutures to close the incision.

the state of being calm and peaceful
She sought the tranquility of the countryside.

the practice of eating the flesh of one's own species
Cases of cannibalism are rare in modern society.

the narrow necklike passage forming the lower end of the uterus
The doctor examined the patient's cervix during the check-up.

a short note or memorandum
The waiter handed him a chit for the drinks.

the natural coloring of an animal or plant
The bird's vibrant coloration helps it attract a mate.

a close friend or companion
He was accused of appointing his cronies to high-ranking positions.

the action of cutting apart a body or plant for study
The biology class performed a dissection of a frog.

the action of purifying a liquid by heating and cooling
The distillation process separates alcohol from water.

the state or feeling of being actively opposed or hostile to someone or something
There was a long-standing enmity between the two rival families.

a person involved in finance
The wealthy financier invested heavily in new startups.

sexual activity preceding intercourse
Foreplay is an important part of intimacy.

clothing, attire
The monks wore traditional garb.

an obstacle or impediment
Lack of funding was a major hindrance to the project.

the act of implanting
The implantation of the device was successful.

a strain of cannabis
Some people prefer the effects of Kush.

object-oriented programming
Many modern software applications are built using OOP principles.

a steroid hormone released by the corpus luteum that stimulates the uterus to prepare for pregnancy
Progesterone plays a crucial role in the menstrual cycle and pregnancy.

an effusively enthusiastic or ecstatic expression of feeling
The pianist played a beautiful rhapsody by Liszt.

A respectful term for a European man in colonial India
The local villagers addressed him as 'sahib'.

A split or division between strongly opposed parties
The church experienced a major schism over doctrinal differences.

A life-threatening condition caused by the body's response to infection
Early diagnosis is crucial for treating sepsis effectively.

A fixed regular sum paid as a salary or allowance
The intern received a small stipend to cover living expenses.

A detective (informal)
The tec was on the trail of the suspect.

the style and appearance of printed matter
Good typography makes text easy to read.

the ease of use and learnability of a human-made object
The new software has improved usability.

temporary cessation of breathing
Sleep apnea can disrupt a person's rest.

the enforcement or advocacy of strict obedience to authority at the expense of personal freedom
The country was slowly sliding into authoritarianism.

a massacre or slaughter
The stock market experienced a bloodbath today.

a large cup or goblet, typically used for drinking wine at Mass
The priest raised the chalice during the ceremony.

a batch of goods destined for or delivered to someone
The store received a new consignment of clothes.

a confusing and difficult problem or question
Solving the economic conundrum required careful thought.

a group of witches
The coven met under the full moon.

a type of rattlesnake
Be careful of the diamondback in the desert.

the territory ruled by a duke or duchess
The Duchy of Cornwall is a royal estate.

the furthest point or limit
His fingers and toes are extremities of the body.

the process of carrying or being carried in the womb between conception and birth
The gestation period for humans is about nine months.

a condition in which part of an organ is displaced and protrudes through the wall of the cavity containing it
He had surgery to repair a hernia.

a person or thing that is central and essential to the success of an organization or operation
He was considered the kingpin of the criminal organization.

a chronic, contagious disease affecting the skin and nerves
In ancient times, leprosy was a feared disease.

an aura of mystery or power
The artist cultivated an air of mystique around his work.

the carrying of boats or goods overland between two waterways
The explorers had to make a long portage around the rapids.

descendants or offspring
The old man was proud of his numerous progeny.

a party that signs an agreement, especially a treaty
All signatory nations must abide by the terms of the treaty.

The process of recording and transmitting the readings of an instrument.
NASA uses telemetry to monitor spacecraft from Earth.

A false, absurd, or distorted representation of something.
The trial was a travesty of justice.

The state or quality of being white; a racial identity.
The whiteness of the snow was dazzling in the sunlight.

a person's order or command
The project was completed at the behest of the director.

mutual trust and friendship among people who spend a lot of time together
There was a strong sense of camaraderie among the team members.

the act of seizing property
The confiscation of illegal goods is a common police action.

the state of being criminal; criminal acts
The government is trying to reduce criminality in the city.

the action of discouraging an action or event through instilling doubt or fear of the consequences
Nuclear weapons are often seen as a form of deterrence.

a person or thing that precedes and indicates the approach of another
The early experiments were a forerunner of modern space travel.

the front of a building or land, especially as it faces a street or open space
The property has a wide frontage along the main road.

a long-bodied, predatory freshwater fish
The angler caught a large gar in the lake.

a collection of traditions containing sayings of the prophet Muhammad
Scholars often refer to the Hadith for guidance on Islamic law.
